plugins.name: koalafix-auto
plugins.description: One memory for every AI tool on your team. In Claude chat: KoalaFix's tools and skill. In Claude Code and Cowork its hooks make it automatic: the team brief at session start, recall on each prompt, a warning before editing a file a teammate has checked in on, one browser sign-in. The hooks send each prompt (keys and tokens removed, never logged) and the file paths it names to your KoalaFix server; teammates see your project, branch and those paths. The hooks need Node.js 22+.
